description: Check a customer's sizes before pricing. Returns ok, problems (must fix), warnings (ask the customer) and advice: size limits for the product, product minimums, centimetre slips, inside-mount reveal depth (single rollers 50mm, no-drill rollers included; Double Roller zebra 90mm; Duo Roller 100mm), no-drill rules (inside only, at least 50mm reveal on rollers and 40mm on 25mm venetians, 2000mm max width, 1500mm on 25mm venetians), face-fix sizing (add 100mm each side and 100mm above and below) and the width we deduct when making an inside mount. Changes nothing and returns no price.

colour.description: Optional exact colour name, checked for stock and width limits

height_mm.description: Drop the customer will enter, in millimetres

mount_type.description: inside (in the recess) or outside (face fix)

no_drill.description: Optional. true for the no-drill option (tension brackets, inside the frame, max 2000mm wide; 1500mm on 25mm venetians). Adds the R65 no-drill kit per blind. Offered on indoor roller blinds, including value rollers, and 25mm aluminium or aluwood venetians. Dedicated no-drill products already include the kit.

opening_drop_mm.description: Optional, face fix only: drop of the opening itself

opening_width_mm.description: Optional, face fix only: width of the opening itself

reveal_depth_mm.description: Optional depth of the recess in mm, needed for inside mounts and no-drill

width_mm.description: Width the customer will enter, in millimetres

name: validate_measurement
title: Check blind measurements
